lines.en: I crawl over the damp soil.

lines.zh: 翅膀折叠在背上，还没干。
lines.en: My wings are folded on my back, not yet dry.
My six legs land in turn.
I push out from under the rotting leaves.
My six legs walk the leaf veins.
I come to that warm stone.
I walk the edge of the fallen log.
I stop and shudder my wing cases.
My shape shows in the water.
I cross a stretch of moss.
I walk half way around the pool.
I head toward that shaft of light.
I climb onto a root.
I move slowly; my wings are heavy.

lines.zh: 我躲在凸起的石头背面。
lines.en: I shelter behind a jutting stone.
I go a little deeper.
I lie on the stone, sunning myself.
My wings aren't hard yet.
I hear water dripping far off.
I slowly clean my antennae.
This wetland is warm.
I try opening my wings.
I want to fly, but I don't dare.
My shell is a bit soft.
There's a smell of rot in the air.
Nothing has found me here.
I tuck myself into the crack.
It's darkening, and the damp will rise.
I crawl slowly to the leaf's underside.
I wait for the damp to rise.
You remember me.
I came out of the earth.
My wings are still folded.
Don't press me with your hand.
I land on the back of your hand.
I lift my head, antennae toward you.
The ground you stepped on is wet.
I crawl into your shadow.
This is more comfortable than the fossil.
My wings are older than this tree.
I draw all my legs under me.
I've flipped over, legs flailing.
A piece of my wing is torn.
I shrink into the moss.
Mud slides off my back.
I'm stuck in the crack.
My legs are still moving.
I'll wait before moving.
One of my wings is crumpled at the corner.
My wings are intact. I can still fly.
That leaf came from the wetland.
That sap smells sweet.

lines.zh: 我的化石，就埋在石头里。
lines.en: My fossil is buried in the stone.
That smell reminds me of mud.
Put the leaf down—I'll chew it myself.
That'll last me a few days.
My antennae touched it once.
I'm not good with hard things.
I sink my mouthparts into the leaf vein.
One more bite — the wing cases still serve.
Your sole is bigger than I am.
I crawl away from your boot.
My wing case knocked once.
I'm too small to matter.
I grab a grass blade to keep from falling.
Flip over, then back again.
A tiny hollow is left in the ground.

lines.zh: 从化石里复活的翅虫，很小。
lines.en: A wing-insect revived from fossil, and small.
I tuck all my legs beneath me.
I carry on the way I was going.
Another crawls out of the moss.
Our wing patterns differ.
We crawl side by side a while.
Its wings are wider than mine.
The water in this wetland is just right.
The eggs will go into the water.
We only touched antennae.
Mating done, we fly our separate ways.
This wetland can raise plenty of us.
I crawl back under the stone.
You've picked me up.
My legs can't grip your hand.
My wings have creased further.
I try crawling onto your knuckle.
It's too dry up here.
I want to go back to the wetland.
The crumb I was holding fell.
Please put me down.
I crawl along your wrist.
I tuck my eggs into the crack.
There's water moving ahead.
I raise my head, antennae straight.

lines.zh: 我翅上的纹路，比叶片细。
lines.en: The veins on my wings are finer than a leaf's.
I've fixed on that smell.
It's ahead of me.
I lift my wings a little.
My legs grip tightly.

lines.zh: 我的鞘翅张开了一条缝。
lines.en: A seam opens in my wing cases.

lines.zh: 石炭纪的翅膀，扇得很慢。
lines.en: Carboniferous wings beat slowly.
One block closer.

lines.zh: 我贴到离水最近的地方。
lines.en: I press close to the water's edge.
This time I jump.
I edge closer bit by bit.
I press to the soil.
I climb up the grass stem.
My wing cases have opened.
When the wind stops, I pounce.
It turned its body away.
I come a little closer.
I listen to its steps.
It's damp here; it won't notice.
I wait a little longer.
My wings are trembling.
Its wings stopped—now.
It lowered its head, so I go around the flank.
I leap and bite it.
My legs clamp onto it.
My wings beat once.
I bump into it.
I flip over and climb up again.
I didn't even pierce its hide.

lines.zh: 薄翅一振，我又撞了过去。
lines.en: One beat of my thin wings and I lunge again.
I fall to the ground.

lines.zh: 我这双薄翅，是石炭纪的。
lines.en: These thin wings are Carboniferous.
It stepped over me.
There's mud on my wings.
I want to try again.
Grains of soil roll off my back.
My wings are still soft.
This is my first look at the sky.
I'm covered in mud.
I've been called back from the fossil.
This wetland is unfamiliar.
I try moving my legs.
The air is damp, just right.
I start crawling toward the grass.
I stop on the stone.
I crawl out of the moss.

lines.zh: 翅上的纹路一条条干透。
lines.en: The veins on my wings dry one by one.
The ferns by the water suit me.

lines.zh: 翅还是软的，我先晾一晾。
lines.en: My wings are still soft; I let them dry.

lines.zh: 火气一逼，我的翅卷了起来。
lines.en: The heat curls my wings.

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下，壳磕破了。
lines.en: I fall from the stone and crack my shell.

lines.zh: 水滴裹住我，我拼命蹬腿。
lines.en: A drop of water swallows me and I kick hard.

lines.zh: 这么小的翅，被气浪吹远了。
lines.en: Wings this small get blown far.

lines.zh: 一根刺穿过我旁边的土。
lines.en: A spine pierces the soil beside me.
That light makes my wings stiff.

lines.zh: 湿地里没有吃的，我越来越轻。
lines.en: There's nothing to eat, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我立刻贴住地面。
lines.en: At the flash I press flat to the ground.

lines.zh: 没有土也没有水，我一路落。
lines.en: No soil, no water; I keep falling.
